Fail-closed current-record precedence does not logically require unlinking its excluded legacy sibling. Retention is not permission to automatically restore stale state. No cryptography, protocol, reducer authority or game-rule weakness is necessary.

Successful authenticated migration/read cleanup and explicit Discard are separate intended operations. This review does not demand retaining every obsolete legacy record forever or resurrecting deleted games.

Never fall back to legacy when current exists and is unreadable.

The smallest platform-local correction is success-only legacy cleanup following authenticated current decryption, keeping the already-required excludeLegacyDirectoryFromBackup before access. Leave successful migration and explicit delete paths intact; update the stale backup-visible rationale and two contradictory old assertions.
Do not turn missing Keychain into empty storage, add entitlements, change key semantics, or claim IOS-R1 repaired. Do not change format/version/game codecs or transmit retained bytes to peers.
proposed_regressions: Use a valid synthetic game-owned snapshot/envelope, not only hiddenRole toy JSON. Invalid version/truncated recognized header direct read AND cold list must fail current load but retain exact legacy/current bytes and true backup-exclusion readback.
Missing key, injected key-read exception, bad authentication tag and CancellationException must retain legacy; cancellation identity must propagate. Current record must never be replaced by legacy.

Successful authenticated current read still returns current data and removes stale legacy; successful full migration encrypts/atomically writes before deletion. Use isolated synthetic key fixtures where needed, not real signing/user material.

Keep existing malformed-magic, legacy-only corrupt/oversized, exclusion failure, retry/recreation, mixed inventory and explicit-discard checks. Discard must remove both without retrying a failed legacy excluder.

Run actual iOS Foundation tests/app-host persistence where available with owned simulator/build cleanup. Local JVM source proof or existing intentionally destructive witnesses are not a passing native repair test.
